summary: Tesla is near the top of its 52-week range at $400. The autonomy optionality (Robotaxi, FSD v13, Optimus) is real and potentially transformational, but current EV margins remain under pressure from price cuts and rising competition. At $400, the market prices in a lot of good news. HOLD unless autonomy catalysts crystallize.
